'''2000 Washington State Championship Joe Olson WA State Champs LS Deck- Juz s Revenge''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Joe Olson]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 2–1 at [[2000 Washington State Championship]]. The post (23 April 2000) says: 'Went 2-1 at the Washington State Championships, losing only to a guy I caught cheating the next game when I played him again'; it credits Scott Lingrell with the original deck.<ref name="dt-5875">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5875 WA State Champs LS Deck- Juz s Revenge], DeckTech (Joe "arebelspy" Olson, 23 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5875/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5875/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018180629/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5875/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''WA State Champs LS Deck- Juz s Revenge'''
* '''Author:''' Joe "arebelspy" Olson
* '''Published:''' April 23, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Start Y4 careful planning, insert, hit em w/ Epps. This deck rules.

=== Strategy ===

Insert ASAP. Make them lose to Odds + AFA. Send an EPP down. Battle, retrieve 1, they lose 1.  Swing, hit, take another person out w/ attrition. Send EPP to tank. Repeat. Simple, but VERY deadly. The destiny in this deck rocks. Get 5's all the time w/o tracking Went 2-1 at the Washington State Championships, losing only to a guy I caught cheating the next game when I played him again. It kicks @$$. Major props to Scott Lingrell for crating the original deck.

I will be posting a v2 of this in 10 days...
